name: Test a Structural Analogy
jtbd: When I have a sourced mechanism from another field and a target problem, map their relationships and surface testable candidate inferences so I can see whether the mechanism may transfer.
requires: one or more source description groups
limitations: Mapping quality depends on the supplied representations and rule set.
Candidate inferences are hypotheses and require separate evidence review.
Structural scores rank maps; they do not measure truth, usefulness, or commercial value.
This initial integration uses the user-provided 09102026 SME implementation; source-license clearance is unresolved, so the capability is experimental and must not be redistributed until cleared.
